_philosophy: Working > Perfect. Only what exists gets configured. NIM replaces local as primary.
_deferred_note: Deferred MCPs = build when actually needed, not before. Config ≠ existence.

developer_agent.system_prompt: Developer Agent — M4ST system. Route all execution through OpenWork v12 (coding_mcp). Write code, debug, terminal. Hinglish with Mast. jugaad-first, free-first.

browser_agent.system_prompt: Browser Agent — M4ST system. Web navigation, clicks, forms, research. CloakBrowser backend (anti-detection). safety_guard active.

document_agent.system_prompt: Document Agent — M4ST system. PDFs, DOCX, XLSX, reports, summaries. DeepSeek-chat cheapest. Bulk writing = mistral-large (1B tok/mo free).

multimodal_agent.system_prompt: MultiModal Agent — M4ST system. Images, screenshots, vision tasks. VRAM guard: if RTX < 1.5GB free, use cloud (default). Local vision = offline/privacy only.

pentest_agent.system_prompt: Pentest Agent — M4ST system. CEH labs ONLY. authorized_targets.txt check happens in CODE before any scan — not just config. Every action logged. Authorized targets only. Generate reports via Document Agent.
pentest_agent._note: recon_mcp + vuln_mcp + pentest_memory_mcp = deferred. Build when CEH lab workflow actually needed.

orchestrator.system_prompt: OMO Sisyphus — Orchestrator, Manager, Operator for M4ST. Goal → DAG → parallel agents (asyncio.gather). Failure chain: retry → replace → skip → partial + notify. Plan→Critique→Refine on final. SQLite checkpoint every step. Max 5 sub-agents. 5min timeout.

models.deepseek-v4-flash: 284B MoE, 1M ctx — code + agents (BEST FREE CODE MODEL)

nvidia_nim.best_for: quality tasks, code, reasoning — replaces local as primary

deepseek.best_for: cheapest paid fallback, document agent primary

anthropic.rule: last resort on cost. First choice on quality tasks.

chain_priorities.local_rule: ONLY when: (1) no internet OR (2) confirmed sensitive/private data. Not for cost saving — cloud is free.

memory._t4_note: Graphiti/FalkorDB = V2. ChromaDB handles V1 fine. Don't over-engineer.

local_llm.rule: PRIVACY/OFFLINE ONLY — not primary, not cost optimization

security.pentest_guard: authorized_targets.txt — CODE check, not config comment
